name: Tsukize no Osugi

location.address: Tsukize, Taira, Neba Village, Shimoina District, Nagano Prefecture

access: Free. Stands in the purpose-built Tsukize no Osugi Park, with parking, restrooms and a viewing pavilion, open to the public.
transport: Roughly 60 to 75 minutes by car from the nearest major highway interchange; limited daily bus service also reaches the site.
verify_notes: Standalone destination tree, the largest tree in Nagano Prefecture and among the largest cedars in Japan (widely cited as 6th largest). Designated a Nagano prefectural natural monument in 1928 and National Natural Monument on 13 November 1944 as an exceptionally rare giant sugi specimen. Girth 13.8m, height 40m. Generally vigorous today, though a branch broke in heavy snow in February 2014; since 2017 the town has been propagating and planting successor saplings from the tree nearby, a sign of active stewardship rather than decline. Flagged only because the age is a broad traditional estimate (1,500 to 1,800 years) rather than a precise dating.
